Pass 11949: the axiflavon fails the quality test -- correction to 11947/11948. The even theta vectors f_0, f_2 are not orthogonal, so the holomorphic eps^2 term breaks the Froggatt-Nielsen U(1) explicitly: over a turn of arg Omega12 the top Yukawa is modulated as a pure cos 2phi with relative amplitude 5.2e-6 (fit A) / 2.0e-6 (fit B). Through the top Coleman-Weinberg term this gives ~1e2 GeV^4 (~1 GeV^4 with TeV SUSY) against a quality bound ~3e-15 GeV^4 -- too large by 1e16-1e17 -- and the top-loop extrema sit at theta-bar = O(1) (A: -3.11, 0.04; B: -1.80, 1.34 at the m_t minima). arg Omega12 is not the QCD axion: the 11947 strong-CP reading and the 11948 f_a/m_a prediction are withdrawn as a solution (rephasing structure and f_a formula stand as statements about the modulus); strong CP is open again. Observation: arg det Y_u = +-pi/4, +-3pi/4 (1%) at every m_t extremum. Correction banners on 11947/11948, Forty Points sentence and ledger row (Claude track)

Pass 11943: the minimal theta-null SU(5) picture gets the PMNS matrix wrong, and a correction to 11942. With L on the 5bar factor, Y_e = Y_d^T (z_e = 6 z_d) and the Dirac coupling Wilson-free (charge rule: -Y_N a = 0), the near-product seesaw neutrino basis is the parity-clean Gram-Schmidt basis at tau_d -- the tri-bimaximal vectors (2e-4 at fit B) -- but the theta parity puts the mu-tau-odd vector at the MIDDLE mass, and the hypercharge-Wilson charged-lepton basis is nearly democratic. PMNS = (45,83,1) or (88,4,45) deg at the best fits and across the quark posterior, against (33,49,9); no neutrino Wilson rule in {1,2,3,-3/2,-3,6} rescues it. The doublet bases must sit at different level-3 points (residual-symmetry misalignment, cf. 11225/11243). Correction: a fifth chain (B, seed 7) excludes the lepton data, so 11942's 'centre of every band' is withdrawn; over the quark-acceptable region the lepton ratios span 0.029-0.081 and 0.002-0.017 (contains the data, excludes minimal SU(5)) -- a band, not a sharp prediction. Forty Points paragraph corrected and extended, ledger row (Claude track)

Pass 11942: a hypercharge Wilson line on the 5bar factor fixes the charged-lepton ratios from the quark fit. With the Wilson line only on the 5bar factor (none on the 10 curve), hypercharge conservation makes the Wilson argument of a coupling minus the hypercharge of its 10 field: z_d = -Y_Q a, z_e = -Y_ec a, so z_e = 6 z_d; the up coupling has no 5bar factor and stays parity-clean (Weber law and neutrinos intact). The quark fit (10 parameters, all 8 observables within 0.4%) then predicts, with no lepton parameter, m_mu/m_tau = 0.053 and m_e/m_mu = 0.0052 at the best fit (data 0.059, 0.0047), and over a quark-data MCMC posterior (4 chains) bands 0.036-0.081 and 0.002-0.012 containing both; minimal SU(5) (Y_e = Y_d^T) misses by 3 and 10, the other charge rules (0, -3/2) fail. Georgi-Jarlskog quality without a 45-Higgs; y_b/y_tau ~ 1.2. Scope: 3 rules tried, local posterior, M_Z-scale ratios; hypercharge-flux lepton/down splitting known qualitatively in F-theory (cited). Forty Points sentence and ledger row (Claude track)

Pass 11940: the Weber invariant is seesaw-invariant. Correction to 11939: a shared Omega would make Y_nu proportional to Y_u (m2/m3 = m_c/m_t, off by 48), so the relation needs a shared tau with channel-specific Omega12. The type-I seesaw m_nu = Y_D M^-1 Y_D with Dirac and Majorana theta nulls at the same tau composes the heat-equation coefficients: R_nu = R(tau) to O(eps_M) (<= 2.6e-4 for eps_M <= 1e-2) and eps_nu = eps_D^2/eps_M (1e-4). With Y_D = Y_u the right-handed masses are (1.9e6, 4.4e10, 5.7e14) GeV and obey the same invariant; this is the SO(10)-inspired pattern, and m1 = 0.80 meV lies just below its N2-leptogenesis window (1-5 meV, arXiv:1012.2343) -- recorded as a tension. Forty Points sentence and ledger row (Claude track)

Pass 11934: the radiative + residual-Z3 principle, applied uniformly, fails in the charged sectors. At the Eisenstein point: up (H_u 2A2) top space 3-dim, symmetric directions give (1,1,0) = top = charm; down/charged lepton (H_d 4.1) top space 1-dim, charge 2, (1,1,0) at w and (1, 1 - O(eps^2), 0) nearby = m_b = m_s, m_tau = m_mu; Weinberg (1,1,0) = inverted ordering. Three charged sectors contradict the data, so the 11933 inverted-ordering reading is sector-specific, not a universal rule; caveat added to the 11933 note. Forty Points sentence and ledger row (Claude track)

Pass 11928: the Eisenstein point of the flavour torus -- residual Z3 generation charges, a W(3,3) line of fixed points, and polynomial (non-Gaussian) hierarchies. At Omega = w.1 the rotation z -> w z is a lattice automorphism, every symmetric flux is invariant, and it acts unitarily (1e-15) on all zero modes: the 10 and 5bar generations carry charges (0,0,2) (the charge-2 one an unbiased, stabiliser-type vector), H_u 3/5/4 and H_d 5/5/6. The 9 orbifold fixed points form A[1-w] = {(x,-x)}, a totally isotropic plane = a LINE of W(3,3), split 3+3 across the flux factorisation K10 + K5; charges localise there (value vectors are R^T-eigenvectors to 2e-15: 3 points of charge 0, 6 of charge 2), so blow-up Kahler corrections commute with the residual Z3 (2e-15) and act inside the degenerate charge-0 block (traceless rank 3); only K10 / K5 among all 130 planes give scalar point sums. Near the point (Omega = w + eps(a + bJ)) the up spectrum scales polynomially: Higgs charge 0 -> m_u/m_c ~ eps^2 (slope 1.99), charge 1 -> m_c/m_t ~ eps (1.00), charge 2 -> m_u/m_c ~ eps^2 (2.01): one hierarchical ratio per Higgs charge, because the two charge-0 generations are degenerate under the residual Z3. A draft reading of a 'vanishing' charge-2 mode was withdrawn (fixed-point value matrix has full rank). Forty Points paragraph and ledger row (Claude track)

Pass 11923: the heterotic local-10 charm-up lock (11903/11908) and the magnetized up lemma (11918) are one theorem, and it survives every Delta(54)-symmetric Higgs vacuum. In both realisations the family index of Q and u^c is a qutrit (fixed points of the Wilson-line-free torus / the 10's magnetic-translation qutrit), the Z3 rule allows Q_a u_b H_k iff a+b = k, and theta evenness equates the off-diagonal values, so Y_u(h)_ab = h_{a+b} g_{a-b} with g+ = g- for a Higgs qutrit state h; 11903's lock is h = Z-eigenstate. (1) All 12 qutrit stabiliser states lock a degenerate pair (1.4e-15 over 200 random even g); the converse fails (54/60 degenerate solutions non-stabiliser, Pauli expectation down to 0.51); Haar h unlocks. (2) Over 300 random couplings the global minimum of the general degree-(2,2) Delta(27)/Delta(54) potential of the Higgs triplet is always a stabiliser state (infidelity <= 6e-11; snapped: same V, gap 2e-16; the classical 3HDM result of Ivanov-Nishi), so the lock survives the full Higgs triplet: unlocking needs a Delta(54)-breaking Higgs potential. (3) Near a stabiliser state the splitting grows like sqrt of the Higgs's stabiliser Renyi magic (log-slope 0.517): a split charm and up need a magic Higgs. Forty Points paragraph and ledger row (Claude track)

Pass 11921: the flux factorises W(3,3) into two flavour qutrits, and the radiatively preferred up Higgs is a flavour qutrit -- but it does not rescue quark flavour. (1) For every det-3 dual pair, K(L10) = l5 x l5 and K(L5) = l10 x l10 are orthogonal nondegenerate hyperbolic planes spanning A[3] = F3^4 (the W(3,3) space): a two-qutrit tensor factorisation chosen by the flux; 10 = qutrit 1, 5bar = qutrit 2, H_u carries exactly qutrit 1, H_d neutral (gcd(m,3) = 1). (2) The qutrit-1 translations permute the three Z3 classes of up Higgs modes, so the top-Yukawa Gram space is exactly 3-dim (4e-15) for every modulus and Wilson line, and there Y_u(h)_ab = h_{a+b} g_{a-b} (1e-13); the down radiative Higgs is unique. (3) Correction to 11918: its 'V_cb = 0 exactly' was a 1e-5 threshold over-read; the small values are Gaussian suppression (4550 below the 1e-12 floor, 6483 in 1e-12..1e-5, 1679 above; a re-run sample gives 6.1e-6 at theta truncation 4 and 7); aligned V_cb scales like m_s/m_b with prefactor ~4e-7 (data ~2). (4) Frozen scans: Haar h (237 moduli, 50244 rows) never gives realistic up masses; fitting h per modulus to m_u/m_c, m_c/m_t, V_us, V_cb, V_ub (87 moduli) gives best log-rms 1.54 / 1.45 -- the charm mass is floored by |g+-/g0| (corr 0.87, 0.97) and a small |g+-/g0| kills the mixing.
